name: notion_block_appender
description: Append structured content blocks — headings, bulleted/numbered lists, code blocks, paragraphs, quotes, to-dos and dividers — to a Notion page or block using the Notion REST API. Handles Notion's 100-children-per-request and 2000-character rich-text limits automatically, and validates all blocks before making any request.

page_id.description: The Notion page or block ID to append children to

blocks.description: List of block specs to append. Each is an object with a 'type' and 'text' (plus type-specific fields).

type.description: Block type: heading, bullet, numbered, paragraph, quote, code, todo, or divider

token.description: Notion integration token. Falls back to NOTION_API_KEY or NOTION_TOKEN env vars

returns.description: Result containing status, page_id, appended_count, batches, and block_ids on success, or an error message
